title: Aethelgard Clean Watershed and Industrial Effluent Standards 2023

sections.heading: Mandatory Continuous Discharge Monitoring
sections.content: Industrial facilities categorized under Tier-A manufacturing must maintain continuous digital telemetry for dissolved heavy metals and biological oxygen demand. Recorded sensor logs must be retained for 5 years and synchronized with the central environmental repository every 60 minutes.

sections.heading: Spill Reporting Protocol and Remediation Timelines
sections.content: Any accidental release exceeding 50 liters of chemical solvent into municipal storm drains requires telephonic notice to the Environmental Hazard Response Unit within 2 hours, followed by a formal incident diagnostic report within 48 hours.

sections.heading: Rainwater Harvesting Mandate for Commercial Zones
sections.content: Commercial structures exceeding 2,500 square meters of roof area must install rainwater retention systems capable of capturing at least 80% of quarterly precipitation. Verification inspections occur biennially by certified municipal hydrologists.

sections.heading: Penalties and Temporary Operating Suspension
sections.content: Facilities exceeding permissible biological oxygen demand limits for more than 3 consecutive billing cycles are subject to an automatic 30-day operational suspension and a punitive assessment of 25,000 credits.
